caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented, metallic object that appears to be an ornate container or box. The object is predominantly brown in color, suggesting it is made of aged or patinated metal. The upper section is cylindrical with a hinged lid at the top. The front face of the upper section is adorned with symmetrical, decorative, scrolling patterns and heart-shaped motifs in relief, as well as a small diamond-shaped opening at the center. The lower section tapers into a conical form with a rounded point at the bottom, and features additional decorative reliefs and a symmetrical motif resembling a stylized fleur-de-lis. The very bottom of the object has a fluted pattern leading down to a small spherical finial. The overall design is intricate, with raised and recessed surfaces that create visual depth. The background is plain and light beige, placing emphasis on the central object. The artist’s name and a number, “Edgar R. Deats – Del. 550,” are inscribed at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Cast Iron Mail Box
